official: 江戸川区特別区税条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会 議案一覧

name: 税の公示送達方法を変更
summary: これまで、区税の公示送達は書面を掲示して行う定めでした。この議案では、公示事項を不特定多数の人が閲覧できる状態に置く措置を加え、区の事務所では掲示のほか、電子計算機の画面で閲覧できる方法も選べるようにします。
changes: 公示事項を不特定多数の人が閲覧できる状態に置く措置を加える
区の事務所での掲示に代えて、電子計算機の画面を閲覧できる方法を設ける
who: 区税の公示送達を受ける人
why: 地方税法の改正に伴い、公示送達の方法を改めるなど、規定を整えるためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Changes how city tax notices are served by public notice
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Edogawa City Special Ward Tax Ordinance
en.summary: Until now, the rules required public service of city tax notices to be carried out by posting a written notice. This bill adds a measure to make the information in the public notice available for viewing by an unspecified number of people. At the ward office, it also allows the information to be viewed on a computer screen, in addition to being posted.
changes: Add a measure to make public-notice information available for viewing by an unspecified number of people
Allow public-notice information to be viewed on a computer screen at the ward office instead of being posted
who: People served with public notices for city taxes
en.why: The ward says this is to revise the methods of public service and make other adjustments to the rules in response to amendments to the Local Tax Act.
